cargoLayoutProbe:
set -eu
cargo_version=$(cargo --version)
printf '%s\n' "$cargo_version" >&2
if printf '%s\n' "$cargo_version" | awk '
  $1 == "cargo" && $2 !~ /-/ {
    split($2, v, ".")
    if (v[1] > 1 || (v[1] == 1 && v[2] >= 91)) ok = 1
  }
  END { exit !ok }
'; then
  echo build_dir=1 > /etc/dagger-rust-cargo
else
  echo build_dir=0 > /etc/dagger-rust-cargo
fi
layoutSelect: if ! grep -qs build_dir=1 /etc/dagger-rust-cargo; then unset CARGO_BUILD_BUILD_DIR; export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/build; fi
packageFingerprint:
set -eu
# Cargo configuration can include arbitrary files or source-based tools.
# Keep those projects on Cargo's existing discovery path for now.
cargo_config=$(find . -name .cargo -print -quit) || exit 0
if [ -n "$cargo_config" ]; then exit 0; fi
metadata_tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/dagger-package-metadata.XXXXXXXX) || exit 0
trap 'rm -rf "$metadata_tmp"' EXIT
if ! find . -printf '%P\0%y\0%m\0%U\0%G\0%l\0' > "$metadata_tmp/layout"; then
  exit 0
fi
if ! find . \( -type f -o -type l \) ! -name '*.rs' -exec sha256sum -b -z -- '{}' + > "$metadata_tmp/contents"; then
  exit 0
fi
layout_sum=$(sha256sum "$metadata_tmp/layout") || exit 0
set -- $layout_sum
layout_digest=$1
contents_sum=$(sha256sum "$metadata_tmp/contents") || exit 0
set -- $contents_sum
contents_digest=$1
fingerprint_sum=$(printf '%s\0%s\0' "$layout_digest" "$contents_digest" | sha256sum) || exit 0
set -- $fingerprint_sum
printf '%s' "$1"
publishLegacyArtifacts:
if ! grep -qs build_dir=1 /etc/dagger-rust-cargo; then
  for f in $(grep -o '"/build/[^"]*"' /meta/build.jsonl | tr -d '"' | sort -u); do
    rel=${f#/build/}
    case "$rel" in */deps/*|*/build/*|*/incremental/*|*/.fingerprint/*) continue;; esac
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    mkdir -p "/out/$(dirname "$rel")"
    cp -p "$f" "/out/$rel"
    sed -i "s#\"$f\"#\"/out/$rel\"#g" /meta/build.jsonl
  done
fi
